using Raw = std::string
class Refusal : public std::runtime_error
  const char* word
  std::size_t offset
enum class Network {Any, Unmetered}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(Network value)
inline std::optional<Network> parse_network(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(Network value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(Network value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, Network value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, Network value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kNetworkNames
inline const std::vector<std::string> kDownstreamRecoveryGuarantees
inline const std::vector<std::string> kCredentialGuarantees
inline const std::vector<std::string> kNetworkCostGuarantees
inline const std::vector<std::string> kWaitingExtensions
struct Constraints
  Network network
struct Artifact
  std::string digest
  std::int64_t size
struct Source
  std::string scheme
  std::string locator
  std::string credential
struct Request
  Artifact artifact
  std::vector<Source> sources
  std::optional<Constraints> constraints
inline std::string encode(const Request& v)
inline Request decode(std::string_view data)
inline std::string encode_constraints(const Constraints& v)
inline Constraints decode_constraints(std::string_view in)
inline std::string encode_artifact(const Artifact& v)
inline Artifact decode_artifact(std::string_view in)
inline std::string encode_source(const Source& v)
inline Source decode_source(std::string_view in)
inline std::string encode_request(const Request& v)
inline Request decode_request(std::string_view in)
